Moss is already powering production pilots across voice AI and developer platforms, achieving sub-10 ms retrieval and 70–90% token savings compared to traditional pipelines.

CustomerOS uncovers high-fit leads who are engaging directly with your brand but not yet in your sales funnel. By lead scoring your pipeline against your ICP we build data-driven profiles of your best customers and provide a real-time ICP-fit indicator so your team doesn't waste time on low-value/high-cost leads. This ensures you're spending your CAC acquiring customers who are primed to renew year after year and expand as they grow. The Top 10% of SaaS companies generate 87% of all market returns. CustomerOS gives you the data and tooling to compete with the top 10%.

RTHM is the self-learning digital clinic for medicine's new normal: complex patients with lots of data and/or multiple chronic conditions. We are focused on infection-associated chronic conditions and autoimmune conditions impacting 70M individuals in the US.
We’re building a brain-computer interface anyone can wear, so you can use a computer at the speed of thought. To get there, we’re recording brain data at model company scale.
Set up in minutes, then let Lysto drive your revenue growth with automatic insights, intelligent answers, and zero busy work.

Blinka is banking for US companies operating globally. Our customers incorporate in the US but run their operations, teams, and vendors from other countries. They use Blinka as their primary operating account. With Blinka, companies can: - Open a USD business account without being in the US. - Send money abroad without the usual 4–5% FX fees. - Earn yield on treasuries. - Issue global corporate cards with 1.5% cash back and 0 international fees. - Manage their financial operations with our AI tools.

Autonomous is a superintelligent financial advisor at 0% advisory fees. Today, managing your money means one of two bad options: DIY your money: You end up with accounts everywhere (401k, IRAs, brokerage, crypto, savings, equity, secondaries). Your spreadsheet is always wrong. You make expensive mistakes because this isn't your full-time job. Hire a financial advisor: They'll manage your money and charge 1-2% of assets annually. Run that math over multiple decades and you're handing over half your net worth to fees. Neither path can economically deliver the sophisticated, personalized strategies the ultra-wealthy use to compound wealth: strategic tax-loss harvesting across individual securities, systematic risk management, portfolio-backed borrowing to defer capital gains, access to alternatives, etc. These aren't secret – they're just economically impossible to deliver at scale through traditional human advisors. Robos were supposed to fix this, but they were designed in a pre-AI world. In practice they just manage cookie-cutter portfolios. They don’t coordinate across your 401(k), taxable accounts, mortgage, equity, and cash flow, they don’t help with real decisions like job offers, windfalls, or concentrated stock, and they don’t deliver institutional strategies. That’s why, even after a decade plus, the biggest robos are still <$100B AUM while old-school advisors like Raymond James / Edward Jones sit on trillions. We’re doing for financial advising what Robinhood did for brokerages. Think of it as a full-stack, AI-native wealth strategist that brings billionaire-style playbooks to ordinary investors. Autonomous is built around a frontier-scale reasoning engine—an AI that perceives global events as they unfold, understanding their deeper implications for markets and and most importantly, how these events will impact your investments.

Amika slices computers you already own (a spare Mac Mini, a desktop, EC2 in your VPC) into isolated agent devboxes or CI runners, and puts them all on one private network you can reach from anywhere. Use Amika to give your agents always-on computers, to offload CI and build to your own machines, or for anything else where you want to run software and agents on your own devices.

At Zumo Labs, we generate synthetic training data for computer vision models. Computer vision is the essential technology that powers the products of the future: autonomous vehicles, smart retail, robotics, smart fitness, security and vision-based analytics. These algorithms require huge amounts of training data. This data is currently collected and labeled manually; a slow, imprecise, expensive process that is rife with bias and privacy issues. Zumo Labs solves all of these problems (and more!) by creating feature rich synthetic training data in the cloud: cheaper, faster to generate and iterate on, covers all the edge cases, and has no bias or privacy issues.

Riveter fully automates web data extraction, end to end. With a single API, agents can search, scrape, and structure data from the web. Customers like Snapchat and OpenAI use us to enrich datasets using Riveter's AI search agents that combine data from the web with third party or internal data. Their AI agents, custom scrapers, and integrations pack the power of browser use and automation for search, at a cost that allows for scale. You can even create a custom data API for repeated searches live in your app or internal databases. Perplexity and ChatGPT are great for single questions, but they can’t handle large amounts of data at once. And they’re working with a single agent and context window instead of one in every cell. And Riveter’s web browsing can go further—even reading PDFs and images that may contain answers. Most teams still spend hours (or hire UpWorkers/contractors) to manually copy product specs, check competitor pricing, pull custom KYB/KYC data to assess customer risk, or scrape filings. Or they spend months building web scrapers, and when that still doesn't work, they come to Riveter. Our founding team (Cody Watters - CTO, Abby Grills, CEO) brings deep product and engineering expertise from to YC-backed companies Gusto, Retool, and Middesk.

We deploy robots in warehouses to automate the most demanding job in logistics: unloading loose-loaded containers. Our customers include 3PLs (CEVA, Stord), distributors (DHL, PostNL) and many more logistics companies.

Visibl Semiconductors makes custom silicon accessible to hardware companies, starting with power electronics. We are an AI-native custom-silicon design partner that cuts ASIC development cost and timeline on mature nodes, helping teams deliver better performance and lower BOM cost. We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances. V1 boards built from off-the-shelf parts are great for getting to market quickly, but scaling to v2+ volume requires optimizing cost, size, and manufacturability. Visibl folds those parts into custom silicon built around the product: a simpler BOM, reclaimed board space, fewer supply constraints, and automation-ready assembly. We manage the full path from architecture and design through verification, fabrication, packaging, and production-ready silicon, working alongside hardware teams so they do not need an in-house chip team.

SkyLink is transforming corporate travel into a hassle-free, efficient experience. By integrating advanced route optimization and reducing the need for traditional travel agents, we're not only saving companies millions but also simplifying the travel process. With SkyLink, employees can effortlessly book their travel, just like sending a Slack message. Trusted by leading global corporations, our platform acts as a pocket-sized travel agent, ensuring smart, cost-effective travel decisions and a smoother journey for everyone involved. SkyLink is where simplicity meets innovation in corporate travel.

Specific builds enterprise environments and datasets representative of work inside real-world businesses. The next frontier of AGI is bottlenecked by data that is hard to access, and we make that easier.

Zudo is building the AI workforce for the $100B+ warranty and extended service contract industry. Our AI workers automate complex, high-volume operations for automotive and home warranty companies — including claims processing, coverage verification, authorizations, customer support, renewals, and sales. Unlike traditional chatbots and copilots, Zudo's agents execute workflows end-to-end, interacting with customers over voice and digital channels while taking actions across existing enterprise systems. We're transforming an industry built on manual processes and phone calls into one powered by autonomous AI workers.

AiSDR builds Ami, an AI sales agent that helps B2B companies find customers and book meetings. Give Ami your website. It researches your business, recommends who to target and why now, and builds an outreach plan. Once you approve, it runs personalized campaigns across email and LinkedIn, follows up, handles replies, and books meetings. Ami keeps working after launch. It monitors results, spots problems with targeting or messaging, and recommends changes or applies them within the rules you set. It remembers your decisions and campaign results, so each campaign builds on the last. Built on lessons from 17,000+ real AiSDR campaigns, Ami gives founders and small teams sales strategy and execution in one place, without having to manage every step themselves.

Rational is building the first accounting firm with no humans. It's entirely run by our AI employees, who go from client intake to doing the books to filing with the IRS. We secure 90% cost reduction, 24/7 support, and an overall seamless experience for businesses.

As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.

Our platform combines cutting-edge AI with deep industry expertise to help investment firms make smarter, faster decisions across their entire deal lifecycle.
Building the next frontier of models that continually learn from a stream of experience.

Through automation, we enable the independent attorneys we coordinate with to maintain quality whilst being more efficient.

Each user receives their own agentic agent who not only answers questions but actually solves problems: applies for jobs and housing, makes referrals, provides training, makes introductions, etc. We make money through advertising and sponsorships, sales of premium services to members, token transactions, events, etc.

Based on three pillars: - A product: a universal self-service platform where builders can train their own models - A catalog of use-cases: We push critical use cases to the limits of human performances in critical markets such as Accounting software, AP Automation, Expense Management, KYC and many others - A internal capability to make tailor-made AI: We answer to specific needs from large customers that needs a custom AI of their own to handle their use cases
Tetra uses AI to take notes on phone calls, to help you focus, remember the details, and keep your team in sync.

We work with background screeners and banks to process thousands of verifications per month.

Our AI SDR Alisha can perform ICP research, find out prospect lists, research about each prospect across 180 web sources, write highly personalized emails to each, follow and engage, and finally coordinate like a human to book sales calls. Businesses using Alisha get 3 key benefits: 1.⁠ ⁠They get 12x output from your existing sales team. 2.⁠ ⁠⁠Are able to scale to 8 figure revenues with just a single AE. Alisha is built on our proprietary function calling model ThorV2 (https://floworks.ai/research) that outperforms both Claude 3 and GPT-4 function calling in accuracy by 13% and 43% respectively. At the same time, ThorV2 uses only a fraction of the cost (<40%) and time/latency (<78%) as the other models. Our second AI employee, Ashley, is an AI Executive Assistant that keeps you reminded and on top of your on your schedule. Works on your whim- just command Flowy to book a meeting, move a meeting or write a email, and it does without you having to navigate through every apps. You can teach Flowy specific workflows such as ‘inform me immediately if i receive a reply from xyz’, “show my unread emails from last day every morning 7am” and much more Our third AI employee, Romona is a helpful AI Revenue Operations Manager that keeps track of every CRM data updation on behalf of your team, works on your instruction to update notes, next steps, MEDDIC after every call, does periodic CRM reporting and much more.

Companies use Sherloq as their single source of truth for their SQL on top of their existing data stack. Today, data-driven organizations face the challenge of giving 2 of their data analysts the same task and getting 2 totally different results from their analysis. Although SQL is the #1 coding language for data analysis, it is still managed independently on each user's internal documentation tools (notepads, Slack channels, or docx files). Creating one source of truth is an ongoing difficult process, that’s done manually and takes time to implement. Using our plugin on top of our user's existing query editors, companies can now manage their SQL code in one place. We ourselves are data users and we've built Sherloq to fit the exact needs of data teams, becoming a true alternative to the way SQL is being managed today.

Safety from humans in the loop is a mirage. We evaluate, research, and apply AI control in our own real-world deployments of autonomous organizations. Building open-source general-purpose robots capable of performing unsafe, repetitive or boring tasks.

This allows us to deliver safer, faster, lower-cost inspections of energy and infrastructure assets with a high degree of accuracy and repeatability. Landeed is the AI-native digital infrastructure for property intelligence, verification, and transactions in India. We provide read/write rails that transform fragmented property and regulatory systems into continuously verified, machine-interpretable state. Powered by Terra, our proprietary property intelligence engine, Landeed converts messy, multi-source records into structured, queryable knowledge that supports legal-grade due diligence, collateral verification, title search, transfers, and property payments. With coverage across 24 states, enterprises go live nationally from day one. We are trusted by Fortune India 500 companies across BFSI, real estate, and retail. Landeed is the blue tick for property.
Hub deploys hardware and embodied machines to collect data for robotics labs, to produce labor output for real world businesses.

Anara is AI for scientific advancement. We help researchers find, understand and write scientific documents, together. We started working on Anara two years ago. In that time: - we’ve grown to 3M users spanning hundreds of major colleges and research-led companies, - we are fast approaching $10M in yearly revenue, - 600M+ people have seen our content across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, - and we raised $3M from YC and the founders of Github and Reddit. We're a small, tight-knit team with huge ambitions. As a founding member, you'll be instrumental in helping us scale revenue from $10M to $100M and then $100M to $1B+. If you’re excited by the idea of being a part of that, definitely reach out.

Party is the secure workspace for your team and agents to build together, in the open. Agent Flows handle 95% of the work and your team can see it all happen and step in when needed to steer. It's built for teams and collaboration first, but caters to the solo builder as well. Use any harness/model - your keys or ours. Cost observability. Memory. Dual-level session sandboxing. Slack/Teams are comm-first with agents as second-class citizens. Party is work-first and the communication happens where the work is being done. Party is for teams who want to build better and faster than their competition.

antimattr is building the hardware interface for human–agent interaction: an AI wearable system made up of a smart ring and voice-isolating earbuds. Voice is the fastest way to instruct an AI agent, but most people won’t use it in public because it’s noisy and unreliable. We think voice AI adoption is held back by hardware, not by model quality. The earbuds use our proprietary voice isolation to capture your voice clearly anywhere, whether that’s a loud pub, a factory floor or a busy street. That means clear calls and dictation/transcription you can trust. The ring is a discreet way to control your agents. Tap to capture a thought, trigger a workflow, or record/summarise a conversation into a searchable personal memory.

At Undermind, we're building a search engine that can handle extremely complex questions. It’s geared at experts, like research scientists and doctors, who need to find very specific resources to solve high-stakes problems. We’ve rebuilt search from the ground up to address this. Our new approach employs high-quality LLMs to adaptively explore a database, mimicking how a human researcher carefully discovers information. This approach dramatically outperforms (by 10-50x) traditional keyword search and other modern AI-based retrieval methods. Our first target users are the 50 million researchers searching for scientific literature on PubMed and Google Scholar every month. We’ve have paying users across fields like medicine, ML, biotech, finance, and more.

Don't die of heart disease. While heart disease is the #1 killer worldwide, 80% of heart disease is preventable. Empirical's program starts with an advanced lab test with 100+ biomarkers, including ApoB, Lp(a), inflammation, and more. Then, we help you model your lifetime risk of heart disease and generate a plan to reduce your risk to an optimal level. Then we help you achieve that plan. Empirical is licensed, registered, and insured to deliver real medical care in 30+ US states covering 200m+ people. We're growing >25% monthly.

Tsenta is an AI career agent that matches you with jobs, applies automatically, and gets you the best offers on the market. We grew to ~$3M Annualized in three months. We built it after manually applying to over 3,000 jobs ourselves, so that candidates would always have someone on their side. Today, more than 90,000+ job seekers trust Tsenta to automate their job search.

Pibit is the AI Underwriting OS for Commercial, Specialty & E&S insurance. Its AI agents run underwriting from submission to quote: they check submissions for completeness and chase brokers for what's missing, clear appetite, ingest documents and third-party data, analyze against guidelines, and give underwriters a risk summary with risk signals, pricing scenarios and benchmarks. Underwriters spend their time only on decisions and broker relationships. 50+ carriers and MGAs across 10+ lines run on Pibit. We guarantee 99.9% workflow accuracy in the contract from day one, go live one module at a time in weeks, and have never had a failed implementation. Pricing is per submission processed, with no license or implementation fee. Based in the Bay Area, with R&D in Bangalore.

Infrastructure for search teams building retrieval and RAG. Trieve combines search language models with tools for tuning ranking and relevance. Building excellent search is difficult and can take months to implement then even more time to maintain. Trieve offers production-ready infrastructure that works out of the box to help search teams build adjustable AI search and RAG into their products. With tools for custom models, relevancy weighting, date-recency biasing, semantic full-text hybrid search, recommendations, and more Trieve covers the full spectrum of what a team wants from their discovery infrastructure.

NFO is building India’s financial education platform for students. We make financial education structured, engaging and competitive through age-appropriate curricula, AI-proctored assessments and nationally recognised certification. Our platform enables schools to introduce financial education without adding to their academic workload, while giving students a measurable way to learn, apply and demonstrate financial knowledge. We’re building toward a future where financial education is a standard part of every Indian student’s education.

Freeport is a trading platform for pre-IPO shares, equities, crypto, and perpetual futures. Our AI analysts turn trusted social and financial media into a real-time feed of market-moving news and actionable trade ideas.

Saatvy is a transparent, personalized and natural wellness platform to manage chronic conditions such as gut/sleep disorder, diabetes, arthritis, and postpartum thyroiditis. The biggest benefit our customers find in the first consultation is understanding the root causes of their health issues, where traditional medicine often falls short. Our Ayurvedic practitioners have decades of experience, with some serving on Ayurveda boards in the USA.

We are building an open source gateway for AI budget holders to control model access and turn their traffic into better models that they own. We're a team that has earned an ML PhD at Georgia Tech, scaled AutoGPT to 160k GitHub stars, and led a self-driving simulation team at Waabi.

OneSchema Studio brings AI Cowork into your private cloud. Teams can clean and validate massive datasets at 1,000x the scale of generic AI tools - data never leaves your network, you pick the AI model, and proven work becomes a skill your whole team can reuse. It self-hosts natively on AWS, Azure, or GCP, gives you granular, role-based control over who can touch what data, and connects directly to the systems you already run - from Salesforce and Workday to SAP and Snowflake.

ML models are only as good as the datasets they're trained on, and that means that most improvement to model performance comes from improvement to the quality and diversity of their datasets. Our tooling makes it easy for ML teams to find anomalies + failure patterns in their datasets and fix these problems by editing / adding the right data. So the next time you retrain your model, it just gets better.

Our mission is to help school districts run like high-performing organizations, enabling them to provide high-quality, personalized instruction to every student.

The world's best AI web app builder, implementing a radically unique architecture that lets us completely outperform the competition in complexity, reliability, scalability, and more. We are 7x cheaper and are positioned to take down Lovable, Replit, Base44, Bolt, Emergent, and more.

A new agent, tool, or generative model alone doesn’t solve the whole problem for most research questions. Someone still has to assemble the data, work out which methods to use and get the tools and datasets working together. We’re building Noto, a multiplayer discovery workbench for human and agentic scientists, to bring everyone's favorite frontier models, agents, tools, and scientific models into one shared workspace, so that you can focus on making your next discovery, rather than wrestling with your Python environment or finding GPUs. Plan an experiment, work with its generated data, run an analysis or model, maybe even train a new model, and keep the results in the notebook. We designed Noto so that the inputs, code, methods and results stay connected across local and hosted compute. Both people and agents need to see how a result was produced and build on it. Biology is where we’re starting, with the workbench being built for more general research across many scientific disciplines. Available now: our first biological analysis tools, hosted model inference, and an initial agent interface. Free usage is available within limits, alongside paid model runs and individual and team plans. Researchers can run sequence and structure analyses and hosted scientific models without provisioning GPUs or maintaining each model’s dependencies. In development: the full multiplayer notebook and wider agent workflows and integrations. Orikata Bio Public Benefit Corporation, or Orikata Bio PBC, is the company. We work under two brands: Orikata Bio for biological discovery and Megure Labs for scientific software. Biological discovery with Orikata Bio We’re developing Ibuki, a world-model family for biology, to learn how evolution, sequence, structure and function relate and use those relationships to understand and engineer living systems. We’re pretraining our own protein language models, and developing coordinate and multimodal models for prediction, inverse folding, alignment and generative design. Proteins are our starting point; DNA, RNA, small molecules, and other biological modalities are part of the longer-term direction. Along the way, we assembled Umi, with over 100 billion unique protein sequences, and Sora, with nearly two billion protein structure records. Having that much data only helps if we can organize it, compare it and find the biology relevant to a particular question. We’re building the full-corpus embedding, indexing and customer access that will bring more of those collections into research workflows. Our key insight was that the fixed substitution tables used to compare biological sequences are the simplest example of a neural network. Replacing them with contextual substitution operators lets us learn how positions correspond, from reference alignments and directly from molecular geometry. Hikoboshi (open source) turns those learned relationships into tools for sequence and structure alignment, search, clustering and many other evolutionary analysis pipelines. GitHub: https://github.com/orikata-bio/hikoboshi Scientific software with Megure Labs Learning those relationships meant making the alignment calculation itself trainable. Orihime (open source), our differentiable-alignment and structured-attention library, lets neural networks learn through scientific algorithms on CPUs and GPUs. It supplies the training machinery behind our learned alignment methods. GitHub: https://github.com/megure-labs/orihime Running the models efficiently is its own problem. Hataya (private evaluation), our inference engine and compiler for scientific models, turns trained models and their dependencies into standalone CPU and GPU programs, carrying the exact weights, identity and verification evidence with them. We’re building it to make both our models and public scientific models cheaper to run, including through Noto’s hosted service. Plover Labs is building toward a future where AI agents write, ship, and maintain most of a company's software. We make it possible for agents to own real engineering roles, not just suggest code for someone else to approve. Coding models keep getting more capable, but enterprise adoption lags behind AI-native startups because enterprises don't yet trust agent output. Each codebase has conventions, history, and failure modes that a general-purpose model doesn't know. We learn those continuously from the code, how the team works, and the mistakes agents make. Then we fix the codebase and add merge gates that use deterministic verifiers instead of another model's judgment, so the same mistake can't ship twice. As the gates build up, agents can be trusted with more of the work. We have five-figure monthly contracts with Series C companies Envoy and Fieldguide. At Fieldguide, we tripled PRs per engineer in one quarter, with the same headcount and PR size.

After seeing AI flood the internet with low-quality content, we created Pixley – a safe, personalized way for kids to turn their ideas into animated stories.

At Redouble AI we have developed Silverlake, a Java-native agentic AI operating system for enterprise. While other AI solutions force enterprise stakeholders to embrace unfamiliar concepts in an unfamiliar language, we do the opposite: we slot agentic AI right into the enterprise comfort zone - by mapping all agentic concepts onto established enterprise primitives in their own language, their own security model, their own infrastructure. It’s like moving from Bitcoin to Stablecoin, just for agentic AI. When we did YC we realized there was no framework or platform that gave us as enterprise and workflow automation veterans what we needed to build truly secure, reliable, and scalable agentic solutions for mission-critical workflows. That’s why we spent the past 18 months building Silverlake from the ground up. We empower the 12 million Java engineers worldwide to write and deploy their own AI, securely, at scale. They define an agent in a few lines of code, and our platform does everything else, from orchestration to permission control, from auditability to rate limiting, from long-running agents to autonomous coordinated networks that perform the work of entire departments. Silverlake has been developed with design partners across biopharma, insurance and financial services. Humance builds and integrates custom AI agents for construction teams, helping them review project documents, identify potential conflicts, and prepare next steps within the tools and workflows they already use. Business users use Melder to: - Accelerate diligence by extracting insights from data rooms - Review contracts by identifying key terms and clauses instantly - Run market research by pulling information from competitor websites - Synthesize transcripts by generating summaries from interviews and calls Melder brings the power of structured spreadsheet logic to the messy, unstructured data world—no coding needed.

Definite connects operational data with finance so businesses that make, move, build or operate things can see what each production run, load and job actually cost. These businesses already record a lot: production runs, shipments, job sites, equipment hours, work orders. Finance records the same business in a different shape. Operating systems track activity by site, line, or day. The ledger tracks it by entity, account, and month. Both sets of records exist, but the link between an operating decision and its financial effect usually lives in spreadsheets and in a few people's heads. So questions that should be routine take days. What happens to cash if one plant adds a shift? How does a change in throughput or staffing flow into the forecast? Which operating changes actually moved the numbers last quarter? Definite connects to existing operational and financial systems read-only. Models propose how operational records map to financial ones and explain what they find. Deterministic rules perform the calculations and checks, so results trace back to the source records they came from. Definite started in a plant office an hour from campus, watching a controller rebuild the same spreadsheet she rebuilds every month to tie her production system to her ledger. The three of us met at the University of Waterloo and had each spent our careers on a version of that join. Gurshabd built wallet policy and approval controls at BitGo, where proving customer assets matched the ledger was still done by hand. Farhan built recommendation systems for Instagram Reels at Meta, joining billions of raw events to the numbers the business reported. Mazin built trading systems at Optiver, then agents for financial analysts at Boosted.ai, where analysts would not act on a number they could not trace. In finance that work is at least funded. In companies that make and move things, nobody had built it at all.

Superserve gives every AI agent its own computer in the cloud. Each one is an isolated VM that starts in under 50ms, sleeps between turns, and picks up exactly where it left off, for hours, weeks or indefinitely. Traditional cloud infrastructure was built to run one app for many users. Agents flip that. Each agent needs its own isolated machine where it can write and run code, use tools and work on its own for long stretches. Everything it produces has to persist the whole time, the way your laptop keeps your work. That means agent computers have to be stateful, secure and cheap to run. For agents that talk to customers, they also have to start, sleep and wake almost instantly. Fast - Machines start in under 50ms, either cold or from a template with your repo and dependencies already loaded. You don't need to keep a pool of servers running and waiting. Persistent - Paused machines keep their full memory and disk state at zero compute cost. They can resume or fork from that exact state. Pausing and resuming is fast enough that a machine can sleep between inference calls and wake on the next turn. Agents can run Docker, databases, browsers or any other service inside. Secure - Every machine is a microVM with its own kernel. You can program the rules for what traffic can come in and go out, and they're enforced at the network boundary where the agent can't reach them. API secrets are handled at the network layer too, so they never enter the machine. Every action is logged for audits. Teams building coding agents, autonomous workers, and eval or RL training environments use Superserve to give every agent session or rollout its own machine, with no infrastructure to manage. We run 100K+ machines every week for teams including Lindy and Y Combinator.

RouterPlus is a marketplace for AI inference. We find the right AI model for a team's product, then get it served at the team's scale, at the best price. Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI agents. For most of software's history the hard part was making things. Writing the code, drafting the document, putting the report together. That is the part that is getting cheap. An agent can now produce in an afternoon what used to take a team a month. What doesn't get cheaper is verifying it. Someone still has to look at what the machine did, decide whether it's right, and answer for that decision later. Output goes up, review capacity doesn't, and that is where the work now piles up. Velt is the infrastructure for that step, and it treats agents and people as the same kind of reviewer. A review agent takes the first pass and catches what a machine can catch. A person makes the call on what actually matters. Both work on the same object, in the same thread, under the same rules. Only after approval is the change applied, through your own webhook, and every decision is recorded, so you can always show who allowed what and when. Teams build this themselves and it takes about two quarters. Comments, approvals, review agents, notifications, audit trails: the boring parts nobody thinks about until they're three months in. With Velt it's a few components you drop into a React, Next, Vue, or Angular app.

Every tool you use was built as an island, so you became the glue between them. You carry a name from Gmail into the CRM, a time from the CRM into Calendly, a note from Calendly into a doc. AI showed up and mostly became an eleventh window to paste into. Sauna is a hybrid of AI and software standing on one shared brain. It holds your context and hands you real software built on top of it. You talk to it like a chatbot and use what it builds like an app: software for the path you repeat, AI for the edge that never repeats. Keep it to yourself, or share the brain with your team. The clearest way to see it is a tool doing what its whole category cannot. An ordinary Calendly shows a stranger your free slots. Your Calendly writes the invite email itself, because it knows how the two of you know each other, and it offers a board member the slot over your gym block, because it knows which of your busy hours bend and for whom. Wordware is the team behind it, 15 people backed by Spark Capital, Felicis, and Y Combinator with a $30M seed, the largest in YC's history. We build foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs. Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab. Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design new formulations in weeks rather than years, at a fraction of the cost. To prove this, we used them to invent three chemicals that never existed before, including a PFAS-free coolant for datacenters, and we have since synthesized and patented all three. We are already working with some of the largest manufacturers to design formulations for them, and we are building our own lab to generate the data that will train our next models.

Floot is the layer where vibecoded software runs. SaaS is dead. Hundreds of millions of people already spend their day in Claude or ChatGPT - and increasingly, when they need an app, they won't buy one. They'll describe it, and it will exist. We're building the infrastructure that makes that real. When Claude creates an app, it needs somewhere for that app to live: a backend, a database, hosting, a domain, the ability to scale, various services, maybe even to be able to work as a mobile app. Floot is that place - a full stack purpose-built for AI to operate, from a specialized framework that defines how AI writes and runs code, down to scalable hosting on AWS. This means you can now build and ship real apps directly inside Claude and ChatGPT. Connect Floot, and the model you already pay for writes and debugs the code, shows a live preview, and publishes to your own domain. No need to wire up git, vercel, supabase and a dozen other providers. And no AI credits - every message runs on the subscription you already have, because we charge for the platform, not for a token markup. We built Floot this way because we've watched the model layer commoditize - every serious builder writes good code now, including us. The lasting value isn't another agent between you and the model. It's the layer underneath, from wherever people already are. With our cutting-edge technology and experienced marketers, we deliver ad campaigns 10x cheaper, better and faster than traditional agencies. In less than a year, we’ve helped 120+ businesses achieve multiple fold growth on their ad campaigns, without the steep fees typically associated with high-quality marketing services. Check out what some of our customers have to say here: usekaya.com/reviews

content.description: Nexa is developing the solution for cattle monitoring, leveraging implantable microchips that collect more comprehensive biometrics than anything else on the market. Our accompanying AI-driven animal health engine empowers farmers with early disease detection, reproductive insights, GPS tracking, and more. We're saving farmers time and money while collecting the world's largest cattle health dataset. We believe that cattle farming should be a science, not an art - this will secure the world's food supply and increase economic output that billions of people depend on.

ZeroPath is a developer tool that autonomously detects, verifies, and submits fixes for vulnerabilities in your code. Engineers can use ZeroPath to find security problems that they might only otherwise catch in pentests or from bug bounty researchers.

Vibecoding has made creating software easy, but launching a real app still means wiring up 5-10 separate cloud services, which stops most new builders. Ample is the one-stop cloud for agents to ship complex web apps. Add Ample to Claude or ChatGPT, tell your agent to "deploy on Ample", and get a live URL in seconds. Ample reads your codebase, works out what infrastructure it needs, and sets up compute, database, storage, CDN, domain and email, with payments, text and analytics next. We then monitor, patch and scale your app so you never have to migrate it. Ravi and Ishan led product and infrastructure engineering for the Shopify App Store, a platform of 25,000 apps used by 5 million merchants and processing $1B in GMV a year. We're doing for software what Shopify did for e-commerce, so that anyone with a computer or even a phone can deploy, share and sell ambitious software from any AI platform.
Founded in 2026, Forward is a San Francisco-based technology company, connecting private credit funds with exclusive loan opportunities, sourced from leading debt advisors across America.

ernd is the credit card for companies that pay for AI. We give 4% back on AI spend and partner with AI infrastructure companies to give cardholders extra perks, like 10% back on Wafer inference, 2x usage limits on Firecrawl and 62% off Trace pen tests. The card is live for US companies. In our first week, 30+ startups requested the card and we signed 8 partners. We combine experience in quant finance at Bridgewater and IMC, payments at Ripple, financial AI at Farsight, and founding an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions. We're also credit card nerds, with at least five cards each that we rotate to maximize points!

Erinys provides the technology, intake, back office, and client acquisition needed to launch and scale an AI-native law firm. Lawyers own their firms and make every legal decision; Erinys handles everything around them.
Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini safely without leaking sensitive data. LogosGuard redacts your private information before the prompt ever leaves your device.

FleetWorks is rebuilding the $1 trillion freight marketplace with AI. Every year, companies spend over a trillion dollars moving freight across the U.S. — but the system for matching trucks with jobs is still slow, manual, and fragmented. FleetWorks is fixing that. We’re turning today’s chaotic freight market into a modern, intelligent marketplace — one where AI agents replace the endless phone calls, texts and emails and match jobs to trucks instantly.
Summer is where people and agents make, play and sell games. It's like Roblox and Unreal Engine, but made to let agents handle the busy work so you can focus on all the fun.

With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data. HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs. Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability layer that lets them understand what they built.
Fetchr is the first personalized shopping app for clothes. Let Fetchr buy you clothes uniquely tailored to you — without any work.

Quadrant Eye is on a mission to improve eyecare access and fight preventable blindness. We're building the next generation eye exam... inside the average American home. Our team wants to enable patients' best and most visually rich lives. To this end, we're looking for curious and nimble minds to help us develop the world's first fully online eye exam and ultimately deliver high-quality eyecare at scale. Some QE highlights: 🐝 We're a team of surgeons, scientists, venture partners, and hackers who mean business. 💸 Our backers include Y Combinator, Khosla Ventures, and the creator of Google Image Search. 🍥 We're a mission-driven company tackling an eye health market worth $USD137B. 🌟 Our core focus is currently the development of patentable deep tech, and our overall vision is to change eyecare for good.
Automatic circuit board design.

Clodo is the planet's best people discovery. Used in GTM, Recruiting, Marketing, and Ops at AI Natives, B2Bs, and Fortune 500s in SaaS, Manufacturing/Industrials, BioTech, Healthcare, Fintech, Compliance, and more

Millions of Americans already care for someone they love. We're building a world where they can get paid for it, with the technology to make the process simple, the support to help them provide better care, and a model that gives more back to those doing the real work.

MixerBox is an AI Super-Apps technology company that helps people live easier through its 24/7 daily-essential mobile apps platform. Founded in 2012 by Harvard alumnus John Lai, MixerBox is backed by the Silicon Valley unicorn accelerator Y Combinator. The company’s apps have surpassed 300,000,000 downloads worldwide, and allow MixerBox users to wake up to MixerBox AlarmTunes, read MixerBox NewsDash, browse with MixerBox ChatAI Browser, pay with MixerBox AI Pay, watch MixerBox FreecableTV, and fall asleep with MixerBox Inspire Meditation. App by app, MixerBox strives to become the “Anything, Anytime Super-Apps Platform” to help people live easier.

Goldbridge is building the financial operating system for the largest asset class in the world – real estate. More than $1T in rent flows through landlord bank accounts annually, with roughly a quarter locked in idle reserves and security deposits – and billions more leaking from unnecessary property expenses. And with $2.5T in real estate loans about to mature in 2027/28, property owners are desperate to boost their income ASAP. Goldbridge solves this problem by creating the first AI-powered banking platform for real estate owners. We are backed by Y Combinator and other world-class investors, and our founding team includes a 2x YC founder, former White House advisor, and 100-unit real estate owner/operator with deep industry expertise. Come help us redefine the future of real estate.

Keet is a mobile app that generates courses on any topic, with short videos for explanation and games for reinforcement. Courses mirror a real curriculum to help you learn over an extended period of time.
AllSome is a Fulfillment-as-a-Service platform for Southeast Asia e-commerce sellers to build self-run fulfillment operations. No upfront fee, 99.99% on time shipping and 50% cost saving.

content.description: Sorcerer is deploying a global network of persistent airborne sensors to fuel advanced weather forecasting. Our high-altitude balloons collect 1000x more data than existing systems and are already used daily by meteorologists to track extreme weather across the US and Central America.

Dynamite personalizes your website for every visitor in under 300ms, so they see what is most likely to convert. It installs on ANY website with one line of JavaScript and typically increases conversion rates by ~20%. Dynamite uses browsing behavior, campaign context and connected customer data to select the right combination of approved content. You control the designs and what can change, through the dashboard or your AI agents via MCP. Dynamite is used across e-commerce and B2B, personalizing across messaging, customer stories, CTAs, product listings, imagery, and more. No two buyers have the same exact reasons for buying, they should see different content. Dynamite grew out of our work building ion.design, helping companies design and improve their websites autonomously with agents.
Our desktop app helps teams stay focused on shipping.

Sanifu automates the repetitive work spreadsheets are used for. Teams across finance, marketing, operations, and revenue simply describe their repetitive work like cleaning and validating data, matching records, preparing reports and moving data from emails, PDFs and Excel exports into dashboards and other systems. Sanifu captures the steps, rules and outputs so the work is repeated reliably every time Some of these work never needed spreadsheets to begin with; the likes of data cleanup, bank reconciliations, report consolidation, payment allocations, channel attributions. Spreadsheets have become the standard workbench for handling these tasks and in the process, teams lose valuable time doing manual data entry, filling templates, formatting data, applying formulas, deleting rows or columns. Sanifu is replacing the spreadsheet while maintaining the logic and processes behind the work, getting you from inputs to your desired outputs in seconds. This significantly reduces time spent on copy-paste work, spreadsheet cleanup, and manual entries and checking, while improving accuracy, consistency, and operational visibility. Sanifu helps teams scale critical back-office processes without relying on brittle spreadsheets, scripts, or general AI tools that reinvent the logic every run. Sanifu is a full operational platform with 5k+ app integrations, 1k+ native functions, forms, scheduler, data stores, dashboards, approvals, reviews, AI-powered entity matching among many other features that make it an end-to-end data app management platform

Transform your iMessage conversations into shareable stories Founded by a team of ex-Google Photos and AI engineers, we’re bringing the same “turn personal data into something you actually come back to” loop to relationships

Airtrain AI is a no-code data platform for Large Language Models. Proprietary AI models such as GPT-4 are very powerful but also very costly, slow, unreliable, and unsecured. As businesses look to scale their AI prototypes into production-grade products, they struggle with large AI bills, slow APIs and large failure rates. On the other hand, smaller language models have been proven to be able to perform on-part with large ones with fine-tuned on high-quality datasets. Airtrain AI lets AI practitioners explore alternatives to proprietary models, build up training datasets, evaluate, fine-tune, and serve a large selection of open-source LLMs.

OpenPipe is an SDK that abstracts away fine-tuning custom models. We capture your existing provider’s prompt-completion pairs in the background and use them to create a new model that is faster, cheaper and often more accurate than the original.

Clearest Health is an AI-enabled revenue recovery platform for independent healthcare practices with underpaid out-of-network claims. Through verified IDR benchmarks, claim analysis, and audit-ready dispute support, Clearest helps providers strengthen No Surprises Act appeals and recover revenue that might otherwise be written off.
Popsy is an AI tool that finds you leads on Reddit and sends them hyper personalized DMs.

We've built voice agents for the largest work comp managed care orgs and specialist PT networks in the country, making >500K calls annually and accelerating the speed at which they coordinate care. On average, our customers see a 40% increase in workflow completion, 10x decrease in cycle times, and >60% reduction in cost. We think voice agents are the starting point for solving slow and fragmented care coordination in this market. Companies that manage an injured worker's care rely on short-staffed contact centres and archaic methods of info exchange: phone, fax, and email. Every delay along the path of care leads to slower rehab of the injured worker, lower throughput for providers, and higher expense for the insurer/employer.

Today, as employees teach AI how to perform valuable company work, the resulting capabilities often remain trapped on individual laptops or scattered across chats and repositories. Mica gives each company a managed, agent-native internal marketplace where employees can publish capabilities, discover them by describing the task they need help with, and install them through the AI tools they already use. Mica tracks ownership, requirements, permissions, and team customizations while letting employees contribute improvements back to the shared version for evaluation and approval. The result: employees stop rebuilding workflows their coworkers have already solved, useful improvements spread across the organization without overwriting team-specific customizations, and security gains visibility without blocking bottom-up innovation. Mica turns scattered AI work into institutional knowledge that compounds.

The American healthcare system is complicated. 88% of US adults cite difficulties navigating the healthcare system. The good news is patient advocacy became a covered benefit by Medicare in 2024. Understood Care matches Medicare patients with a healthcare personal assistant (known as a Patient Advocate) at little to no cost to the patient. Patient Advocates help patients patients access care - finding resources, helping fill out paperwork, and much more. Understood Care uses AI and healthcare expertise to deliver the highest quality patient advocacy to the 68 million Medicare patients in the US.
We help businesses convert leads into sales in minutes using text

Avocado is a modern point-of-sale system for restaurants, powered by a built-in AI agent. More than just a POS, Avocado combines order management, KDS, kiosks, and online ordering in one platform - and lets restaurants control everything with simple voice or text commands. Want to change your menu, check your sales, or optimize pricing? Just ask. Avocado’s AI understands your business and takes action instantly, freeing up owners and staff to focus on what matters most: great food and service.

Vogent is an all-in-one platform for building voice agents by using intelligent building blocks, including IVR detection models, custom phone-ready LLMs, drag-and-drop conversational flow builders, and more.

Glimpse is the leading AI platform for CPG brands - automating key back office workflows like deductions management, revenue recovery, & cash application to increase operating leverage and put millions of dollars back into a brand's pocket. Our agents automatically retrieve deduction data, validate charges, automate cash application, and dispute invalid claims to recover lost revenue—often starting with a lookback of the past year of deductions. For a $1B CPG, one agent reviewed 17,000 deductions in under 24 hours (work that would take an FTE ~2 years), identifying $10M+ in revenue and driving meaningful margin expansion. Pricing is simple and incentive-aligned, structured to create clear P&L impact from day one.

Vaero's AI produces the most human sounding writing in the world. User's input their own writing, and Vaero automatically trains custom models to write exactly like the user. It writes emails, reports, brand content, and anything else. Vaero bolts on to any existing foundation model, such as GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 3.5, so you can always use the latest model in your writing style.
Top Road provides no-code analytics & payment tools so creators can monetise their AI apps ("GPTs") in the OpenAI ecosystem.

Frontrunner lets GTM teams describe the work they need done and deploy agents that run it, connected to their existing tools and data. Our customers are building agents for everything from inbound lead routing to signal-based outbound and multi-touch attribution. Think Cursor for GTM: the place to engineer your revenue factory. GTM engineers and rev ops teams spend their days stitching tools together; and fielding requests from sales and marketing. Each campaign has its own version of who the customer is, what makes a lead qualified, and which signals matter. When the business changes, someone has to update that logic everywhere. Even teams that can build their own tools end up depending on the person who built them to keep everything running. Not only does Frontrunner give those agents a shared understanding of your ICP, customers, and gtm motion, but persists that shared understanding automatically when business context changes so that it remains in sync. Sales and marketing build, run, and manage agents against that shared context, using the tools they already know. As prospects move from first touch to closed deal, the results feed back into how agents target, qualify, and engage the next account. Your revenue factory gets smarter with every cycle, optimizing for conversion across the full sales journey. Our customers range from AI native startups to agencies running GTM for their clients to established businesses supporting large sales teams. They use Frontrunner to turn their best plays into agents their whole team can use.

Aside is an AI browser that completes real work across the websites you already use. It can sign in through your browser, work inside email, dashboards, internal tools, docs, and spreadsheets, and keep going when a task takes minutes or hours. Unlike agents that depend on integrations, Aside uses the web the way you do. Browsing history becomes local memory, so it knows which tools and context matter. Its password manager lets agents autofill credentials without exposing secrets to the AI. Sensitive actions like payments, posts, and messages wait for your approval. We achieved state-of-the-art on agentic browsing benchmarks, surpassing OpenAI and Anthropic's result- Aside ranked #1 across Mind2Web, Odyssey, bu-bench-v1.

Humoniq is fully automating customer support for travel & transport industries, which outsource $20B of customer support each year. Our AI-native approach improves speed, accuracy, and satisfaction. We handle support requests across phone, email and chat. And because we connect directly to Sabre and Amadeus, we don’t just answer questions, we fully resolve complex issues. As a result, airlines need far fewer people and travelers get help much faster. Our team is uniquely equipped to solve this challenge. We previously grew a travel management company, Flightfox (YC S12), to $25M/yr. We handled thousands of customer requests each month, which exposed the limitations of traditional outsourcing.

Osseus is building the frontier biomedical AI research lab, starting with the evaluations, reinforcement learning environments, and datasets that help AI labs train more capable, aligned, and safe models. We post-train models for medical and biological tasks, and deploy these in biotech, pharma and healthcare systems to ultimately improve patient outcomes.

Intuned is a code-first browser automation platform with an AI agent that builds and maintains your automations. Developers use Intuned to deploy scrapers, RPAs, and crawlers as production-ready TypeScript or Python projects — with stealth, CAPTCHA solving, proxies, auth, and scheduling handled out of the box. The agent builds projects from a prompt, fixes failed runs, and can self-heal automations autonomously when websites change.

Tempo is a visual editor for react that gives PMs, designers, and engineers the ability to collaborate visually on code. It offers the familiar UX of a design tool but functions like an IDE under the hood. Tempo is optimized for Vite and Tailwind.

Casetext, the most widely used A.I. legal research technology, has been adopted across the legal market from the largest Am Law 100 law firms to solo practices. Its award-winning technology offers both conventional search functionality and its CARA A.I. powered contextual search, focuses on the context of your research to help you find on-point authorities faster. Founded by a team of former litigators from top law firms, as well as Ph.D. data scientists and leading A.I. engineers, Casetext helps legal researchers find the best cases, faster, including many that they would otherwise miss. For more information, visit www.casetext.com or contact our team at contact@casetext.com.

Query Vary is a no-code tool for building LLM-powered automation. Example use cases include extracting information from a sales call transcript and piping it into a CRM, creating a Slack bot trained on product documentation, or transforming Google forms into fully formatted reports. Input Software --> LLM --> Output Software Our extensive toolset to make each workflow reliable sets Query Vary apart. Book a demo: https://calendar.app.google/6oxEvZA2k4kK6dBa8

Grade is the AI agent for affiliate and creator programs. Describe your program and Grade sets it up. It tracks every view, sale and install, then pays everyone worldwide with built-in tax compliance.
www.charcoalengine.com

We’re building the AI copilot for radiologists, powered by a foundational model for medical imaging. RadMate AI will read radiology images and generate full reports for radiologists to review and submit. Mohamed and Adam are technical co-founders who met while studying Computer Science at Cornell University. Before starting RadMate AI to solve the problems his dad faced as a radiologist, Adam worked at Palantir on the initial launch of Palantir’s Al Platform. Mohamed has experience at AWS, where his goal was to help enterprises innovate on the cloud, and PathAl, where he worked on their image viewer platform to improve the workflow of pathologists.

Turn-key solutions for anomaly detection, asset detection and tracking, and workforce management in automotive and manufacturing operations. We leverage modern Machine Learning to work with unstructured sensory data, like video and audio. By distributing the solution across the edge (on-premises) and multiple clouds (Azure + AWS/GCP) we lower the operating costs by 100x, while processing 1,000x more data than any cloud-based solution and provide better reliability and safety.

We rewrite and optimise your internal documentation for AI, giving it deep enterprise context. This unlocks substantially better LLM results across all AI workflows. PROBLEM: -------------- • AI teams struggle with LLM accuracy building AI workflows and agents because of messy, conflicting, fragmented internal knowledge. • Internal knowledge conflicts, uses undefined jargon and rely on unstated company assumptions & context. • LLMs are like Day 0 fresh hires – they can’t understand this documentation properly without someone explaining context to them. • Furthermore, vector search suffers from poorer retrieval accuracy when company context and terms are not present in a knowledge article WHAT WE DO ------------------- • Clean & De-Conflict: Our AI agents read every doc, resolve contradictions, and builds content relationships. • Context Distillation: Our AI agents read & compare related docs, distills context and rewrites an LLM-optimised version of your internal documentation. Optional human-approval ensures 100% confidence in the output. THE OUTCOME ---------------------- • Agents and chatbots that actually understand your enterprise context. • Retrieval that delivers precise, policy-aligned answers on the first try. • A living knowledge base that stays synchronized with every new doc revision.

Airbyte is the open-source data integration and ELT platform that makes your data ready for AI. 700+ connectors move data from any source into your warehouse, lake, or database. The same connectors now give AI agents governed access to that data through Airbyte’s MCP server, so your warehouse becomes your agents’ context layer. Run fully managed in Airbyte Cloud, self-host the open-source version, or go hybrid: we manage the control plane, your data never leaves your environment. Trusted by 20% of the Fortune 500 and over 40,000 companies worldwide.

We work with AI labs to improve models on formal verification. We have $100k in contracts across two formalization RL environments and a $200k LOI for our broader coding data. Our team includes Olympiad medalists, former members of frontier labs, PhDs, and former Google engineers. We’ve published papers at leading AI conferences, including NeurIPS, ICLR, and IJCAI. We’ve formed the densest community cluster of 12,000 IMO, IOI, and ICPC medalists.

Redapto builds the intelligence that runs the real world, closing the gap between understanding and execution. By combining real-time context, specialized AI agents, and adaptive orchestration, Redapto takes ownership of complex, mission-critical operations from end to end. Acting as an always-on operational brain, it coordinates across people and systems, improves every decision, and grows more capable with every task.

Orca is a game launcher for Minecraft. Players browse games and experiences and join with one click, no mod installation, no setup. We handle hosting and mod delivery for server owners and game creators, who earn revenue from their games. Think Roblox, but built on top of Minecraft's 312M player base.

Dropbase is a prompt-based app builder that empowers developers to create custom back-office software fast and efficiently. With Dropbase, you can build backend panels, order/billing dashboards, and internal tools that can fetch data and trigger action across any database or service. Key Features: * Rapid development of backend panels, order/billing dashboards, and internal tools * Seamless data fetching and action triggering across any database or service * Intuitive prompt-based interface for streamlined app development Dropbase customers are companies in support and operations-intensive industries such as financial services, telecom, logistics, and retail that want to: * Dramatically reduce software development costs * Enhance operational efficiency * Accelerate the creation of tools to empower business teams

Endstack is a full desktop, collaborative workspace built for humans and agents running in the cloud available on web, desktop, and mobile. Each workspace powered by endOS, giving you a familiar channel-based experience augmented by a real desktop environment. The desktop is backed by Linux and ships with a built-in Chrome browser. Files, notes, browser tabs, native apps, terminal, and all your agents in a single beautiful, unified interface. At the center of it all you get a powerful agent running 24/7 that you can also reach via Slack, email, or SMS.

We are building robots that can work autonomously in existing wet labs. Unlike traditional lab automation, which requires dedicated equipment and fixed workflows, our robot moves between workstations, manipulates existing scientific equipment, transports lab materials, and executes experiments using the same lab infrastructure as a human technician. We make the robots easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs as easy as onboarding a new employee, and to accelerate scientific research!

Skyvern helps companies automate browser based workflows using LLMs and Computer Vision, fully automating manual workflows and replacing brittle or unreliable scripts. Examples include: 1. Automating materials procurement from commerce websites 2. Completing complex multi-step workflows (ie getting an insurance quote from Geico.com) 3. Automatically logging into portals and downloading invoices 4. Navigating legacy content systems to do data extraction or data entry

ProcIndex uses AI to automate accounting operations for the construction and manufacturing sectors. It connects to your existing ERP and operates in the background while giving you full visibility into its actions. By automating accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliation, and vendor management, ProcIndex helps accounting teams improve efficiency by 33%.

Topological is developing physics-based foundation models for CAD optimization. We help hardware teams iterate at the same speed that software teams do. Our technology is accelerating the engineering workflow with AI and scales design and optimization to identify the ideal designs for complex problems given their physical constraints with enhanced speed and performance. Our first model, UToP-v1, is a SOTA topology optimization model that understands physics, geometry, and manufacturability. It can generate the most efficient design given a problem’s physical requirements. It has <5% compliance error and is 1930x faster than current methods. We're reimagining mechanical engineering and computational design with precision spatial AI.

Nomi.so provides on-the-spot phrase suggestions, intelligently crafted from your transcribed sales calls and a custom playbook that adapts and grows with you, from founder-led sales to revops mastery. PS: We also increase closing rates by 12% on average and free up your sales team's mental energy.

We’re on a mission to enable everyone to build reliable AI agents & AI applications. We're fully open source, and provide a unique integrated development & observability experience for those building anything in the AI space. This is the first step towards laying the foundations for Composable AI Systems; all AI systems need observability and introspection to be first class for them to be reliable. How? We're standardizing how people write python to express data, ML, LLM, & agent workflows/pipelines/applications with lightweight frameworks. So that no matter the author, it'll be easy to collaborate, connect, and importantly in one line integrate observability and datastore needs. This speeds up time to production and reduces TCO because code remains easy to maintain and your data flywheel stays manageable. So you can increase the top line & bottom line of your business by delivering on AI that is reliable. We've got two open source projects: - one focused on AI applications, called Burr (https://github.com/dagworks-inc/burr). - one focused on AI pipelines/workflows, called Hamilton (https://github.com/dagworks-inc/hamilton) see https://www.tryhamilton.dev Both Hamilton & Burr come with self-hostable UIs (+ enterprise & SaaS offerings). With a one-line code change, you get versioning, lineage / tracing, cataloging, and observability out of the box with Hamilton. With Burr you get tracing, observability and persistence in a single line addition.
Next-Gen API Documentation with AI Brilliance. Generate Stripe-like API docs in just a few seconds.

Stockline is an AI-native ERP for food wholesalers. Our agents eliminate human labor for repetitive tasks, starting with order entry. Our goal is to replace clunky software with the next generation of ERPs, built with AI employees at their core. Team is 2 Polytechnique alums who dropped out of Stanford and MIT. Mariem is daughter of the fish industry and Moncef started coding and building softwares at 13.

Flair Labs is the leading AI communications platform for lending, empowering teams to build autonomous agents that execute complex workflows across voice and text. We believe the next generation of top lending teams will be responsible for managing swarms of agents that execute tasks on their behalf – Flair Agent platform is the foundation enabling this future.
Every student deserve personal attention. With AI, we can infinitely scale personalised learning experience at scale to every student. That's what we are building at SuperKalam.

AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs. All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex. Mireye is building the infrastructure that powers agents to make decisions and act in the real world. One API and MCP to connect agents to the physical world with accurate data enrichment, signals and tools. Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.

SnapCalorie is the world’s first app where you can take a photo of ANY meal and get an accurate calorie count. It takes seconds to use and is more accurate than a trained nutritionist. The team previously co-founded Google Lens, Cloud Vision API, and published a CVPR paper demonstrating the first algorithm to outperform a professional nutritionist at calorie counting.

Tegore follows K-12 school curriculum to design courses like Algebra I & Algebra II. In addition to working with high schools in the Bay Area to design the best in-classroom experiences, Tegore is developing the corresponding consumer product, a Duolingo for Math. Each lesson in Tegore follows a lesson plan (e.g. Polynomial Long Division), and the content is delivered with voice / interactive visuals, and checks students' understanding by using dialectic teaching.

In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it. Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on. The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade. Kimpton OS goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions, connects to the institutional data the fund already runs on, and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss. That same work is how we grade AI. Static benchmarks leak into training data. Simulations reward what their authors imagined. A forecast sealed before the outcome exists and scored when the company reports can't be rehearsed or backdated. We started in markets because they're the one place reality answers on schedule. We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund, raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We learned to trust live results over historical fit. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack. We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager. Our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B, and the labs that need to know whether their models can do this work.

Lingo.dev is the localization engineering platform: the best way to translate with LLMs, measure translation quality, and proofread with native speakers. Lingo.dev is built for teams accountable for quality in languages they can't read. Teams configure localization engines, stateful translation APIs that hold the glossary, brand voice, and per-locale model preferences, and every request retrieves that context at inference time through retrieval augmented localization. Every translation is scored before it goes live, scores and corrections tune the engine, and the localization team runs the localization infrastructure. Integrate through the API, CLI, CI/CD, or native integrations with the code repository and the CMS. At Litmus, we’re solving this problem. CoAsync automates the workflow by: Reading supplier documents Extracting laboratory data Validating product specifications Applying compliance requirements Drafting compliant COAs Organizing audit-ready documentation Results from one of our initial deployments with a mid-market food processor: 85% less QA administrative work 4× more COAs processed per shift 1-2 hours saved per document New product onboarding in under one day COAs are just the beginning. Conductor Quantum is building quantum superintelligence: AI that operates quantum computers to make scientific discoveries beyond human reach. Quantum computers let us understand the world at its most fundamental level, the path to new drugs, new materials, and discoveries no human can reach alone. A quantum computer is the perfect simulator of nature: it encodes the logic of reality into a programmable machine, atom by atom, electron by electron. Give AI that simulator and you open the door to discovery. The bottleneck is operating the hardware. Today, engineers spend days or weeks by hand to bring a chip to operating conditions for just two qubits. A qubit is the information-carrying unit of a quantum computer, the equivalent of a bit in a classical one, and a useful machine needs billions. Removing the human from that loop is only half the problem. Every command an AI sends to a quantum computer must be optimised for the specific hardware it runs on. We build the AI that operates quantum computers and tunes every machine it runs on. That is the path to quantum superintelligence.

Tilo gives AI agents one shared computer. Today every agent gets its own virtual machine and works by screenshots and clicks, which is slow, expensive and brittle. Agents that work together have to describe what they did to each other in messages. Tilo is a Linux-based operating system built for agents as users. Every app exports typed actions that agents call over MCP while people use the same actions as buttons, on the same live state. Many agents work in one workspace at once and read each other's work instead of messaging about it. Every change is attributed and can be undone, and irreversible actions need permission. Because state and interface are separate, agents can generate an app's entire UI on demand. On the same multi-app task with the same model, agents on Tilo were about 29× cheaper and 90× faster than computer use, which failed. A small model on Tilo did it for about 1/10,000 of the frontier model's cost. In our scale test, 50 agents worked in one shared workspace on a single laptop, at about 60 MB of memory per agent. Tilo runs headless, in our cloud, or as a desktop, and you can open any workspace from the browser.
